title: My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute To Live With! Releases Teaser PV and Cast News
content: The Deregula YouTube Channel has revealed a promo video for My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute to Live With! The PV featured information on some of the anime’s cast and staff. Doukyo Shiteiru Kensei o Onna Shinshou ga Kawisugite Mainichi Shiawase Desu will premiere in January.
author: Anime Corner

title: This Solo Leveling Competitor Ended With No Season 2 Hopes, But It Really Needs More Episodes
content: The Fall 2026 anime season has finally begun after concluding the Summer series. While the ongoing season is airing the sequels of The Apothecary Diaries and Black Clover, the previous season was famous for unique debuts.

title: How Not to Summon a Demon Lord Ult Releases Visual & Staff Details
content: The production committee for How Not to Summon a Demon Lord ULT has released a teaser visual and details about the main staff. Tezuka Productions will return to animate the series. Studio Okuruto Noboru, which worked on the previous season, will not be involved. Satoshi Kuwabara is also returning as director.
author: Anime Corner

title: 5 Fall 2026 Anime That Nailed Their Premiere
content: It is already the last season of 2026, but the anime industry is still not done for the year, as the Fall season is filled with dozens of great anime that have already aired, with many more yet to come.

title: Unique 2027 Isekai Anime Aims To Take The Genre In A New Direction – Watch
content: Isekai is a powerhouse genre within the anime industry that continues to grow every year despite fans oftentimes echoing that the reuse of tropes and low-effort story lines of each new series getting pushed out season to season has caused something of a fatigue toward to concept among audiences.

title: 7 Years Later, Attack on Titan Director Opens Up About MAPPA’s Takeover
content: WIT Studio was established in 2012, and the very first anime produced by the studio was Attack on Titan . Based on the award-winning manga written and illustrated by Hajime Isayama, the anime debuted in 2013 and didn’t take long before capturing viewers’ attention.

title: Firefly Wedding Manga Gets Live-Action Adaptation on TV in 2027
content: The official website for the television anime of Oreko Tachibana 's Firefly Wedding ( Hotaru no Yomeiri ) manga announced on Saturday that the manga is getting a live-action adaptation on Fuji TV in 2027. The website streamed a video, but it is not available in the U.S.
author: ANN
